Scope: The native Windows assets of this one package version (runtimes/win-x64, win-x86, and win-arm64), as a transitive dependency of Microsoft.Data.SqlClient. No shipped artifact contains them.
Reason: Every SqlClient release depends on the package. The Phase 2 images are Linux-only, and a publish for Linux does not contain the Windows assets. The terms allow use to develop and test applications, and distribution only with protective terms and an indemnity, so a Windows artifact must never ship it. ADR-0004, amendment of 2026-11-03.
